title: 秋の行事の飾り罫
lead: お月見・ハロウィン・運動会・紅葉・きのこ・七五三など、秋の行事の区切り線12点です。見出しの下やおたよりの区切りに使える横長素材です。
subject_en: Horizontal decorative divider lines, each ONE wide thin strip about 6:1 in shape, centred in its cell with space around, made of repeating small motifs along a line. Strips are separate and never touch each other. Flat style. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a line of moons, pampas grass and dango
a line of pumpkins, bats and stars
a line of small flags and ribbons
a line of mushrooms and leaves
a line of candy bags and pine
a line of pine, bamboo and plum
a line of mittens, scarves and snowflakes
